id: title:Gilbert09:stop the source catalog requesting missing icons

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse source configuration and test setup for M3TER and other warehouse connectors.
review.reason: The change P1.F1.H1 updates the icon path for the M3TER warehouse source, potentially resolving a missing asset issue. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 establish the necessary imports and test configuration to support warehouse source handling and icon availability checks. This represents a localized maintenance and configuration update.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the new icon path is correct and deployed; this review cannot verify the existence of the asset or the success of the fix, only the code change. No broader systemic changes or critical path improvements are demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, PR metadata, or release notes are provided. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F1.H1 changes the icon path for the M3TER warehouse source from '/static/services/m3ter.png' to '/static/services/m3ter.com.png'.
observations.posthog_connection: This could resolve a missing or incorrect icon path for the M3TER warehouse source, potentially fixing a 404 or fallback to a placeholder in the warehouse source catalog. The change assumes the correct icon now resides at the new path.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F2.H1 adds imports and configuration setup in the test file, including the pathlib module and Django settings, and imports the source loading module.
observations.posthog_connection: These imports are prerequisites for the subsequent test implementation and configuration, not independently meaningful.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F2.H2 adds a set of warehouse sources whose declared icon paths do not have corresponding files, and a helper variable ICON_ROOT to resolve paths against the frontend public directory.
observations.posthog_connection: This establishes a baseline of warehouse sources with missing icons, which the subsequent test uses to distinguish between sources that should have an icon and those that are exempt.
